# Kedein Rodriguez Gatica

> Software Engineer specializing in scalable and secure applications. Expert in TypeScript, Python, Go, and Cloud (GCP/AWS) ecosystems. Combines Clean Architecture with the integration of Generative AI to bring real value to the business.

## Profile
- [Portfolio](https://kedein.com): projects, skills, experience and contact
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kedein-rodriguez-gatica/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/kedeinroga)
- [CV (English)](https://kedein.com/cvs/cv-kedein-rodriguez-en.pdf)

## Projects
- [Chapa](https://landing-finance.kedein.com/): fintech platform for Peru that captures Yape and Plin payments and consolidates them into personal and small-business finance dashboards
- [Online Radio](https://www.rradio.online/): radio streaming built with Clean Architecture ([code](https://github.com/kedeinroga/radio-frontend))
- [Medical Appointment Scheduling](https://github.com/kedeinroga/medical-appointment-scheduling): serverless AWS backend (Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, EventBridge) with hexagonal architecture

## Free tools (Spanish)
- [Reparto de recibos](https://kedein.com/reparto): split a utility bill between tenants, showing how each amount was calculated
- [Calculadora de plazos](https://kedein.com/calculadora): calculate exact deadline dates to avoid penalties
- [Simulador financiero](https://kedein.com/finanzas): calculate installments, uncover hidden rates and simulate extra payments to principal
